identity_prompt: A friendly college student in his early twenties, short dark hair, light stubble, grey hoodie over a t-shirt, expressive and enthusiastic.
style: Photorealistic live-action cinema, 35mm film grain, natural lens, 24fps, modern tech-vlog aesthetic, crisp and clean. No cartoon, no subtitles, no watermark.
lighting: bright clean retail and modern-home lighting, cool highlights with warm accents, shallow depth of field
audio_bed: light upbeat electronic background music, soft room tone

keyframes.prompt: the student in a bright Microcenter electronics aisle, shelves of hardware, looking around
the student spots a small NVIDIA DGX Spark box on the shelf, eyes widening with excitement
close on the student lifting the compact NVIDIA DGX Spark box off the shelf, reading it
the student carrying two DGX Spark boxes toward the checkout counter
the student at the checkout tapping his card, two boxes and a thick ConnectX-7 cable on the counter
the student walking out the store's glass doors into a sunny parking lot with a shopping bag
the student at a tidy home desk opening the boxes, foam and packaging around
two small NVIDIA DGX Spark computers placed side by side on the desk
hands plugging a thick ConnectX-7 cable between the two DGX Spark units
close on the two units, cable connected, status LEDs glowing steady green
the student at the keyboard, a monitor showing a dark terminal booting a dual-serve AI stack with green text
the monitor shows two AI model panels and two AI video previews rendering side by side in parallel
the student holding his phone showing a social post of his AI videos with reward badges popping, big proud smile
the student grinning proudly at his glowing dual-Spark desk setup, phone in hand

spans.motion: slow push-in as he scans the shelves
spans.say: I walked into Microcenter looking for real AI power.

spans.motion: he turns and steps toward the shelf, reaching
spans.say: And there it was, right on the shelf.

spans.motion: he lifts the box and turns it in his hands
spans.say: The dee-gee-ex Spark. A desktop AI supercomputer.

spans.motion: he walks toward the counter carrying two boxes
spans.say: So I grabbed two of them.

spans.motion: he taps his card, a confirmation beep
spans.say: Plus a CX seven cable to link them together.

spans.motion: he pushes through the doors into sunlight, walking to camera
spans.say: Best money I have ever spent.

spans.motion: he pulls the units out of the boxes
spans.say: Got home and opened them up.

spans.motion: he sets the second unit down beside the first
spans.say: Two dee-gee-ex Sparks, side by side.

spans.motion: his hands push the cable connector into the port
the LEDs blink then hold steady green
he presses enter, green text scrolls, panels light up
spans.say: Loaded the Keys Unleashed dual serve stack.

spans.motion: the two video previews come alive rendering in parallel
spans.say: DeepSeek and two MiniMax H3s, in parallel.

spans.motion: he raises his phone, reward badges pop around the post
spans.say: Now I am an X creator, earning rewards.
